slug: 2017-01-01 AU - Report on the Status of Civil Registration and Vital Statistics in Africa
note: A continental monitoring report (October 2016 round) that gives Egypt only composite scores: 80-100% on digitisation of the civil registration system, and 80-100% overall, the only country in that band; it does not give Egypt's own answers on electronic capture at local offices, so no aspect value can be taken.
